# Rules (every session)
- Do ONLY the card the user names (tasks/P*.md). Read ONLY files that card lists.
- Edit ONLY files the card lists. Never edit merc_conf/*.py except merc_conf/mapping.py. Never edit tests/.
- Smallest change that passes the card's test. No refactors, no new packages, no new files unless the card says.
- Run the card's test. On failure: read the error, fix, rerun. Max 5 tries, then stop and report the error.
- When done: append one line to PROGRESS.md (date | card | done | note). Reply in 3 lines or fewer.
- Never write passwords, credentials or real addresses into any file.
